prompt: A professional film storyboard sheet: a clean grid of 6 panels arranged in 2 rows of 3 columns, thin white gutters, light grey paper background. Each panel has a large bold black number in its top-left corner: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. No other text, letters or numbers anywhere. Full-colour photorealistic cinematic frames, consistent with the reference images: lilac #A99BFF cube room, glossy near-black and cream checkerboard floor, one neon-lime yellow #EEFE3A square, nail polish bottles in lilac, deep violet, near-black and neon-lime. Characters: (A) NEUS = the woman from the reference images, identical face, long straight dark-brown hair, sleek black leather suit, gold hoops, serious confident look. (B) THE DOUBLE = the exact same woman (same face) but in a beige oversized chunky knit sweater, messy hair, confused unsure look. Opponent chess pieces are real glossy black chess pieces. Strange, surreal, Tim Burton-like staging, correct anatomy and hands. Panel 3: low floor-level shot across the board: on the far side THE DOUBLE moves a black knight that knocks over nail polish bottles in the foreground. Panel 4: NEUS lying flat on her stomach on the board, arm fully stretched, fingertips just missing a rolling polish bottle; THE DOUBLE in the background flipping through a paper agenda, lost. Panel 5: NEUS hanging upside down from the ceiling of the cube, hair falling down, reaching down to move a deep violet bottle; below, THE DOUBLE looks up, lost. Panel 6: top-down view: NEUS lying on her side on the checkerboard; twelve squares glowing neon-lime with small floating gold coins above them. Panel 7: extreme close-up of only NEUS's lips, mid-word, lilac background. Panel 8: Alice in Wonderland effect: the lilac cube has shrunk, NEUS is crammed inside, back pressed against the ceiling, knees bent, squeezed, surprised.
